title: Hunger Vital Sign questions
about: The Hunger Vital Sign's two statements about the household's food in the past 12 months (Children's HealthWatch), for any form that screens for food insecurity.
rows: Within the past 12 months we worried whether our food would run out before we got money to buy more.
Within the past 12 months the food we bought just didn't last and we didn't have money to get more.
